note: Hand calculations with stated assumptions (beams, cantilevers, friction and contact models, mesh overlap tests on the real geometry), written by the designer and challenged by four independent reviewers. Not FEA and not lab tests: the physical tests below are what settles them.
assumptions: Phones: iPhones from Apple's dimensional drawings (exact); the Xiaomi from photos (12T Pro +-2.5 mm), every value a parameter in phones.py with a fit-test band.

Load case: phone + case + plate at 10 g in any direction, with the true 3D lever from each section to the phone's centre of mass. Limit 1/3 of strength at 10 g; PLA/PETG ~50 MPa along layers, ~20 across.
Printed parts in PETG for use; constant preload kept <= 5 MPa (creep).
Ultra-wide frame: 4:3 frame from the 35 mm-equivalent focal length + ~2 deg; every head turn that can be fitted, both candidate Xiaomi lenses.

Phones as rounded slabs from phones.py (Apple drawing exact; Xiaomi from a photo, +-1.5 mm); camera = plateau + lens rings. Cases TPU 95A. Plates/feet/heads/wheels PETG in the use version (PLA for fit tests): strength ~45-50 MPa along layers, ~20 across (limits below use the PLA figures, PETG is tougher across layers).
Load cases: phone + case + plate at 10 g in any direction (knocks, handheld action); limit 1/3 of strength at 10 g.

Wheel clamp: 0.5 Nm on the Ø30 scalloped wheel (spec in the README, checked in the test plan); T = F (0.16 P + mu r_thread / cos 30 + mu r_face), mu 0.3 (plastic on plastic), r_face 8.5 (the wheel bears on the lips at r ~6.4-12).
GoPro joint: M5 x 20 countersunk, knob torque 0.5 Nm, K 0.2-0.3 -> clamp 330-500 N.
Ignored here, covered by physical tests in the README: TPU lip peel strength, printed-thread fit, CA strength, creep.

rounds.label: Round 1
rounds.note: First design: TPU cases for the Xiaomi 12 Pro and iPhone 13 mini, swappable shoe / prong plates, foot + wheel + 3-prong head + glued knob.

verdict_notes.functionality: one blocker: the head was not held on the foot's key

rounds.label: Round 2
rounds.note: Head locked by an M3 pin, M12 stud, head2, prongs_x, mount moved out of the ultra-wide frame, button covers, corner bumpers, one rounded window.

rounds.label: Round 3
rounds.note: 3D load levers + M4 steel core in the stud, wheel clearance measured on the mesh, soft button covers + fit bands, head3 keyed out of the one turn that showed in the ultra-wide.
